The complete diagnosis

A taxonomy of being online.

Ten collections for the systems, rituals, aspirations, and minor humiliations that keep the feed moving.

01 / SOCIAL MEDIA THEATER

Everyone is performing. Some have ring lights.

Thought leadership, promotions, public vulnerability, and career journeys nobody asked to follow.

“Delighted to announce I remain employed.”
02 / ALGORITHM ANXIETY

Seen by twelve people. Judged by a machine.

Engagement systems, recommendations, benchmarks, relevance, and computational validation.

“My self-worth is buffering.”
03 / CREATOR ECONOMY

Everything is content if you disrespect the moment enough.

Personal brands, monetized memories, candid takes, funnels, and audience dependence.

“I turned my personality into a funnel.”
04 / CHRONICALLY ONLINE

The outside world has poor refresh behavior.

Doomscrolling, notifications, read receipts, attention, and the inconvenience of offline life.

“Offline is currently unavailable.”
05 / ARTIFICIAL AUTHENTICITY

Genuine feelings. Professionally color-corrected.

Edited vulnerability, automated relatability, genuine prompts, and human-generated errors.

“Authenticity now available as a service.”
06 / FUTURE OF WORK

Your replacement is currently rebooting.

Beta coworkers, autonomous supervision, valuations, and labor that needs a software update.

“Fully autonomous. Adult supervision required.”
07 / PRODUCTIVITY THEATER

Looking busy remains fully operational.

Alignment, calendar identity, status updates, deep work, and visible busyness.

“Busy is my core competency.”
08 / PERFORMATIVE SUSTAINABILITY

Values, now printed on recycled paper.

Renewable outrage, carbon-neutral decks, offsets, incentives, and branded water bottles.

“Reduce. Reuse. Overnight delivery.”
09 / TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Your personality requires a subscription.

Premium tiers, free trials, privacy with ads, and forgotten memberships.

“Basic personality. Premium features.”
10 / OPTIMIZED HUMAN

Rest harder. Recover competitively.

Tracked sleep, wellness metrics, recovery routines, and quantified self-care.

“Mindfulness, but competitively.”

More low value content incoming

Only the strongest observations become shirts.

The first six are being developed now. Future drops will follow the symptoms that refuse to improve.
